name: tag-group
description: A source-owned Dioxus-only Tag Group component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` per statics/catalogs/dioxus-components.json and tracked in statics/component_compatibility.json, not shadcn parity. Grouped multi-select tag input reusing the roving-focus collection infrastructure already imported for Select; no document::eval, portal, or DOM measurement API, so it is SSR-safe by construction.
documentation.accessibility: Implements the WAI-ARIA APG Grid pattern (a single-row-per-item grid, not a listbox): `TagList` is `role="grid"`, each `TagOption` is `role="row"`/`role="gridcell"` (`packages/adico-primitives/src/tag_group.rs`). Escape-clears-selection and roving `aria-rowindex` are this file's own design, informed by shadcn/Base UI conventions rather than an ARIA-authored precedent.
documentation.keyboard: Arrow keys move roving focus among tags; Escape clears the current selection; each tag's own `TagRemoveButton` is independently focusable/activatable for keyboard removal.
